title: stmt_cache hot-SQL fast-path bypass
impact: Tried short-circuiting `stmt_cache_lookup_entry`'s linear scan with a `last_lookup` pointer set to the most recently matched (or just-inserted) entry, so a hot loop on one SQL skips re-scanning every other cached entry on every call. Rejected: three order-flipped pairs on the new `stmt_cache_hot_sql.dart` harness show no candidate-faster median on any cache-pressure lane, and a reproduced +6% to +30% slowdown on the very lanes the fast-path was meant to help. The `sql_len` short-circuit already makes the existing scan very cheap; the added branch + cache-line shift in `resqlite_stmt_cache` outweighs whatever the fast-path saves. Prototype preserved at `archive/exp-207`; the new focused harness is the lasting deliverable.
